p1: In 2017, scientists dug up a serial killer's grave... to prove he was really in it.
For over a century, people said he'd escaped the hangman.
In 1893, near Chicago's World's Fair, he built a three-story building.
Newspapers called it the Murder Castle. Trapdoors. Secret rooms. A chute to the basement.
Historians say most of that... was never proven.
He confessed to 27 murders... but some of his victims were still alive.
So in 2017, they dug ten feet down... and hit cement.
He'd asked for that himself. So no one could ever dig him up.
His clothes were preserved... and his mustache was still there.
His teeth matched. It was him. How many he really killed... no one will ever know.
